files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A restaurant menu board: category sections with DishCards in a grid, or denser menu rows in a list or a
  sectioned column. Axes: layout (sections, grid, list), prices (show, hide), density. Composes DishCard;
  section rows use MenuRow.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Dish, FoodLabels } from "./dish-showcase.types";
import type { DishSection } from "./restaurant-menu.types";

export type MenuBoardProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  dishes: Dish[];
  sections: DishSection[];
  empty?: string;
  labels: FoodLabels;
  layout?: "sections" | "grid" | "list";
  prices?: "show" | "hide";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Grid from "../compose/Grid.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import DishCard from "../blocks/dish-card.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import MenuRow from "../components/menu-row.vue";
import MenuSectionNav from "../components/menu-section-nav.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  dishes,
  sections,
  empty = "",
  labels,
  layout = "sections",
  prices = "show",
  density = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<MenuBoardProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :lead="lead" :density="density" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel">
    <EmptyState v-if="((sections?.length ?? 0) === 0)" icon="star" :title="empty" />
    <Stack v-else gap="8" align="stretch">
      <MenuSectionNav
        v-if="((layout as string) === 'sections')"
        :label="labels.sections"
        :sections="sections"
        :prefix="id"
        :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
      />
      <Box class="flex flex-col gap-8" data-testid="items">
        <Stack v-for="s in sections" :key="s.id"
          :gap="(((density as string) === 'compact') ? '2' : '4')"
          :id="tpl('{0}-{1}', id, s.key)"
          data-testid="menusection"
        >
          <Stack gap="0" class="border-b border-border pb-2">
            <Title :as="3" size="xl" weight="bold">
              {{ s.title }}
            </Title>
            <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ s.note }}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
          <Grid v-if="((layout as string) === 'grid')" cols="1-3" class="gap-4">
            <template v-for="d in dishes" :key="d.id">
              <DishCard v-if="(d.tag === s.key)"
                :dish="d"
                :labels="{ add: labels.add }"
                :media="(((density as string) === 'compact') ? 'none' : 'image')"
                :prices="prices"
                action="none"
                :density="density"
              />
            </template>
          </Grid>
          <List v-else tag="ul" class="flex flex-col">
            <template v-for="d in dishes" :key="d.id">
              <MenuRow v-if="(d.tag === s.key)" :dish="d" :prices="prices" />
            </template>
          </List>
        </Stack>
      </Box>
    </Stack>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
